card.title: Conversational brand activation
card.excerpt: A WhatsApp chatbot to register the World Cup promo's winning codes — no apps, no complicated forms.

paragraphs: During the World Cup, Corona launched a nationwide promotion with winning codes printed on its products. The challenge was clear: make registering a code as simple as sending a message — no app downloads, no long forms.
We built a WhatsApp chatbot that guided consumers step by step inside the conversation: it validated the code, confirmed whether it was a winner and securely registered their data, all in real time.

challenge.label: Challenge
challenge.text: Enable mass registration of winning codes with zero friction, on a channel people already use every day.

solution.label: Solution
solution.text: A conversational WhatsApp chatbot that validates codes, identifies winners and securely captures data, available 24/7.

result.label: Result
result.text: An activation that turned every package into a direct touchpoint with the consumer, with entries registered in real time.
